cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the treasurer's page out of the fair briefing. We can't have the stallholders replacing the chair before the gates open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'donated decoration' on the public sheet. The accounts stay separate, please. Use the briefing to keep people at their stalls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the shortfall, but she must sign an IOU.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Prepare it privately for after her welcome. Date and amount, please, but don't give her a debt form to sign at the microphone.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 public-sheet versus accounts and A5 private IOU timing make professional event management conceal a chair financial failure to preserve her position.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 stall funds spent on arch explains shortfall; B4 funding offer with debt condition can be fulfilled privately after welcome.

relationship.evidence: B2 names problem and B4 offers concrete remedy with accountability, both used instead of dismissed.

heightening.evidence: B4 IOU condition causes A5 private document preparation and timing away from public microphone.
